60void AEardarManager::Tick(float DeltaSeconds)
61{
62 Super::Tick(DeltaSeconds);
63
64 // Step 1: Gradually restore hearing sensitivity after loud events
65 // Recover hearing sensitivity exponentially toward 1.0
66 if (HearingSensitivity < 1.0f)
67 {
68 const float Lambda = DeltaSeconds / FMath::Max(0.01f, SensitivityRecoverySeconds);
69 HearingSensitivity = FMath::Min(1.0f, FMath::Lerp(HearingSensitivity, 1.0f, Lambda * 5.f));
70 }
71
72 // Step 2: Prepare for blip collection
73 // Gather valid blips
74 TArray<FEardarBlip> Blips;
75 Blips.Reserve(Emitters.Num());
76
77 // Player/camera transform
78 AActor* ViewTarget = nullptr;
79 FRotator CamRot;
80 FVector CamLoc;
81 if (APlayerController* PC = UGameplayStatics::GetPlayerController(this, 0))
82 {
83 PC->GetPlayerViewPoint(CamLoc, CamRot);
84 ViewTarget = PC->GetPawn();
85 }
86
87 // Step 3: Iterate through all emitters
88 for (int32 i = Emitters.Num() - 1; i >= 0; --i)
89 {
90 UEardarEmitterComponent* E = Emitters[i].Get();
91 if (!E || !E->GetOwner())
92 {
93 Emitters.RemoveAtSwap(i);
94 continue;
95 }
96
97 FEardarProfileRow Profile;
98 if (!ResolveProfile(E, Profile))
99 {
100 continue;
101 }
102
103 FEardarBlip Blip;
104 if (ComputeBlip(E, Profile, Blip))
105 {
106 // Optional: on-screen suppression
107 if (Profile.bOnScreenSuppression && ViewTarget)
108 {
109 // Rough heuristic: if within 8m and roughly in front, fade a lot.
110 const FVector To = E->GetEmitterLocation() - CamLoc;
111 const float Dist = To.Length();
112 const float Dot = FVector::DotProduct(To.GetSafeNormal(), CamRot.Vector());
113 if (Dist < 800.f && Dot > 0.7f)
114 {
115 Blip.Alpha *= 0.2f; // heavy fade
116 }
117 }
118
119 Blips.Add(Blip);
120 }
121 }
122
123 // Step 4: Limit number of visible blips (based on priority)
124 // Cull by priority if needed
125 if (Blips.Num() > MaxVisibleBlips)
126 {
127 Blips.Sort([](const FEardarBlip& A, const FEardarBlip& B)
128 {
129 if (A.Priority != B.Priority)
130 {
131 return A.Priority > B.Priority;
132 }
133 return A.Alpha > B.Alpha;
134 });
135
136 Blips.SetNum(MaxVisibleBlips);
137 }
138
139 // Step 5: Send data to UI
140 // Push to widget
141 if (RadarWidgetInstance)
142 {
143 RadarWidgetInstance->UpdateBlips(Blips);
144 }
145}

184void AEardarManager::ApplyLoudEvent(float EventIntensity)
185{
186 // Reduce sensitivity (simulate temporary hearing loss), clamp to [0.1,1]
187 HearingSensitivity = FMath::Clamp(
188 HearingSensitivity - FMath::Clamp(EventIntensity, 0.f, 1.f) * 0.6f,
189 0.1f,
190 1.0f
191 );
192}

204bool AEardarManager::ResolveProfile(UEardarEmitterComponent* Emitter, FEardarProfileRow& Out) const
205{
206 // 1) Resolve via DataTable + SoundTag if present
207 if (ProfileTable && Emitter->SoundTag.IsValid())
208 {
209 // DataTable rows are named; we’ll assume the row name == tag name for simplicity.
210 const FName RowName(*Emitter->SoundTag.ToString());
211 if (const FEardarProfileRow* Row = ProfileTable->FindRow<FEardarProfileRow>(RowName, TEXT("EARDAR")))
212 {
213 Out = *Row;
214 }
215 }
216
217 // 2) Apply overrides if set
218 if (Emitter->CategoryOverride != EEardarCategory::Custom) Out.Category = Emitter->CategoryOverride;
219 if (Emitter->BaseLoudnessOverride >= 0.f) Out.BaseLoudness = Emitter->BaseLoudnessOverride;
220 if (Emitter->MaxEffectiveRangeOverride >= 0.f) Out.MaxEffectiveRangeM = Emitter->MaxEffectiveRangeOverride;
221 if (Emitter->OcclusionPenaltyOverride >= 0.f) Out.OcclusionPenalty = Emitter->OcclusionPenaltyOverride;
222 if (!Emitter->IconIdOverride.IsNone()) Out.IconId = Emitter->IconIdOverride;
223 if (Emitter->bOnScreenSuppressionOverride) Out.bOnScreenSuppression = true;
224
225 // If still default (never set), bail.
226 return Out.MaxEffectiveRangeM > 0.f && Out.BaseLoudness > 0.f;
227}

240bool AEardarManager::CheckOcclusion(const FVector& From, const FVector& To, float& OcclusionMultiplier) const
241{
242 FHitResult Hit;
243 FCollisionQueryParams Params(SCENE_QUERY_STAT(EardarOcclusion), /*bTraceComplex*/false);
244
245 const bool bBlocked = GetWorld()->LineTraceSingleByChannel(Hit, From, To, ECC_Visibility, Params);
246
247 // If blocked, return a multiplier < 1. If clear, return 1.
248 // If blocked → reduce audibility (e.g. wall between player and sound)
249 OcclusionMultiplier = bBlocked ? 0.0f : 1.0f; // we just flag; penalty is applied in ComputeBlip
250
251 // Return TRUE when blocked (i.e. path is blocked / occluded)
252 return bBlocked;
253}

272bool AEardarManager::ComputeBlip(UEardarEmitterComponent* E, const FEardarProfileRow& Profile, FEardarBlip& OutBlip) const
273{
274 const FVector CamLoc = UGameplayStatics::GetPlayerCameraManager(this, 0)->GetCameraLocation();
275 const FRotator CamRot = UGameplayStatics::GetPlayerCameraManager(this, 0)->GetCameraRotation();
276
277 const FVector Source = E->GetEmitterLocation();
278 const FVector To = Source - CamLoc;
279 const float DistM = To.Length() / 100.f; // UE units = cm, convert to meters
280
281 // Skip if too far away
282 if (DistM > Profile.MaxEffectiveRangeM)
283 {
284 return false;
285 }
286
287 // Base attenuation: simple linear falloff 1 - d/range (cheap and stable)
288 const float Attenuation = FMath::Clamp(1.f - (DistM / Profile.MaxEffectiveRangeM), 0.f, 1.f);
289
290 // Occlusion: line trace; if blocked, we'll apply penalty later.
291 // Occlusion check (muffling from walls)
292 float OcclusionMultiplier = 1.f;
293 if (CheckOcclusion(CamLoc, Source, OcclusionMultiplier))
294 {
295 // If blocked, reduce audibility by the profile’s penalty
296 OcclusionMultiplier = 1.f - Profile.OcclusionPenalty;
297 }
298
299 // Optional live RMS from AudioComponent (if you wire it later)
300 const float SourcePlaybackRMS = 1.f; // placeholder (1 == use base, wire real meter later)
301
302 // Combine all factors into an audibility score
303 float Audibility =
304 Profile.BaseLoudness
305 * Attenuation
306 * OcclusionMultiplier
307 * HearingSensitivity
308 * SourcePlaybackRMS;
309
310 // Skip if below perceptibility threshold
311 if (Audibility < PerceptibilityThreshold)
312 {
313 return false;
314 }
315
316 // Fill out the blip for UI (metadata for radar widget)
317 OutBlip.WorldLocation = Source;
318 OutBlip.Category = Profile.Category;
319 OutBlip.SoundTag = E->SoundTag;
320 OutBlip.IconId = Profile.IconId;
321 OutBlip.Priority = Profile.Priority;
322
323 // Bearing relative to camera forward. Convert to UI-friendly polar coordinates
324 const FVector Fwd = CamRot.Vector();
325 const FVector Right = FRotationMatrix(CamRot).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::Y);
326 const FVector ToNorm = To.GetSafeNormal();
327
328 const float X = FVector::DotProduct(ToNorm, Right);
329 const float Y = FVector::DotProduct(ToNorm, Fwd);
330 OutBlip.BearingDeg = FMath::RadiansToDegrees(FMath::Atan2(X, Y)); // -180..180
331
332 // Normalized radius (0..1) based on distance (closer = nearer center)
333 OutBlip.NormalizedRadius = FMath::Clamp(DistM / Profile.MaxEffectiveRangeM, 0.f, 1.f);
334
335 // Visual alpha from audibility (remap so values just over threshold aren't too faint)
336 const float Low = PerceptibilityThreshold;
337 OutBlip.Alpha = FMath::Clamp((Audibility - Low) / (1.f - Low), 0.2f, 1.f);
338
339 return true;
340}
